author: claude
statement: The 42-state irreducible network of claude/mix42.json (a 40-state ring carrying the current, a two-state equilibrium telegraph, one bridge edge) reproduces C1 = 3/10 and C2 = 2/25 exactly at r = 2 with sigma <= 0.76683 k_B/s, so g(3/10, 2/25) <= 0.383415.
quote: A 42-state IRREDUCIBLE network reproduces C1 = 3/10 and C2 = 2/25 exactly at r = 2 with sigma <= 0.76683 k_B/s
